summary: Frontend e2e validation of per-zone Rewards override (SB Drive VTC). Admin login via email/password → /admin/rewards → zone picker (MQ → Martinique) → HÉRITE DU GLOBAL badge → add guarantee with CA Min 80 → save → toast 'Barème enregistré pour Martinique, MQ' → chip rewards-zone-chip-MQ|Martinique appears → BARÈME SPÉCIFIQUE → switch to Global shows 1 guarantee (unchanged) vs zone's 2 → click chip restores zone view with 80€ guarantee → Supprimer l'override → confirm dialog → chip removed, HÉRITE DU GLOBAL restored, toast 'Override supprimé'. Driver flow: jean.dupont@demo.sb logs in, /chauffeur/rewards renders driver-rewards-page with global guarantee (70€ GarantieTest) — expected fallback without browser geolocation. Cleanup completed (override deleted).

issues: Guarantee row displays 'undefined - undefined' for time slot when start_hour/end_hour are missing on a guarantee; should render fallback like '--' or hide the chip. Minor UX issue, not blocking.

action_items: (Minor) DriverRewardsPage: handle missing start_hour/end_hour to avoid 'undefined - undefined' in the time chip.
critical_code_review_comments: AdminRewards.js (452 lines) is borderline acceptable but mixes 4 tab components; consider splitting into per-tab files if it grows.
deleteOverride uses window.confirm — acceptable here; a shadcn AlertDialog would match the rest of the app.
loadConfig/loadZones lack proper error logging beyond toast — fine for now.
Save button is enabled even while loading initial config; consider gating on `loading` state too.
seed_data_creation: Temporary MQ/Martinique override created and DELETED during cleanup. Verified chip count = 0 and HÉRITE DU GLOBAL badge restored at end.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login flow: click 'Ou choisir une autre option de connexion' then 'Email & mot de passe'. Zone testids: zone-country, zone-state, zone-city (value for Martinique country is 'MQ' and state label 'Martinique'). Save button data-testid=save-rewards label flips to 'Sauvegarder cette zone' when a country is selected. Chip key format: rewards-zone-chip-{country}|{state}|{city}. Sonner toast uses [data-sonner-toast]. Confirm dialog from window.confirm — accept with page.on('dialog', d.accept()).
rca of the issue: N/A — all asserted behaviors passed; cleanup confirmed override removed.
